baseline_models.focus_anchor: The event-day, the separating judgment, the divine gathering, and the inclusion of former people.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe occasion assembles a mixed multitude, including those marked by temporal precedence, into one forum; the judicial branch of separation supplies the operation that distinguishes within that collection.

activation_trace.role: A severe event or major occasion gives the assembly an exceptional temporal setting.
Decisive judgment that distinguishes truth from falsehood defines the assembly's operative purpose.
An assembled and potentially mixed multitude supplies the population on which distinction acts.
Beginning and precedence extend the assembly to earlier human cohorts.

changed_reading.before: A named future day on which the addressed people and earlier people are present.
changed_reading.after: A universal assize collects earlier and addressed generations into one forum specifically so decisive judgment can distinguish within the total multitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The single event-day gathers the addressees together with those who preceded them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The open-span branch of day, the gathering-day or summons branch, and the precedence branch of the former ones turn chronological separation into accountable co-presence.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time permits the day to hold more than an ordinary daylight interval.
A gathering-day, place, or summons turns the time expression into a point of convergence.
Temporal precedence supplies the distant cohort whose distance is overcome.

changed_reading.before: The former people are simply one additional group in the crowd.
changed_reading.after: The event makes chronological precedence converge: addressees and beginning cohorts occupy one accountable present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise, occurrence, appointment, terminal delay, and the earlier naming of the separating judgment form a schedule; the focus demonstrative presents that scheduled event as the now-arrived assembly.

activation_trace.role: The severe occasion is the event whose arrival the surrounding schedule prepares.
Decisive judgment identifies what the scheduled event performs.
The gathering-day image supplies the concrete convening at the deadline.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the scheduled horizon.
Falling and becoming fixed turns the promised horizon into an occurrence.
Fixing something by a time or limit makes the event formally appointed.
A terminal time supplies the deadline reached in the focus declaration.
The same decisive judgment is named earlier as the answer to the scheduling question.

structural_cues: 77:7 promises an occurrence; 77:11-14 appoint and name its day; 77:38 presents that day and its assembled parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, occurrence, appointment, deadline, and repeated event-name; I infer that the focus demonstrative marks the schedule becoming present. A live alternative is that the demonstrative only renews emphasis rather than temporal arrival.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies a generic future tribunal.
changed_reading.after: The verse announces that the promised and deferred deadline has crossed into presentation: this is the appointed event, and its parties have been convened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from violent dispersal through spreading to deliberate differentiation is reversed and completed by the focus: scattered material is gathered so that controlled distinction can replace indiscriminate fragmentation.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into a collected whole reverses the earlier dispersive motion.
Separation that exposes a boundary supplies the controlled result of regathering.
A violent wind that scatters things supplies the initial centrifugal motion.
Opening, spreading, and branching extend the field that must later be recollected.
Deliberate discrimination between two things anticipates separation as ordered sorting.

structural_cues: 77:2-4 presents a rapid dispersal-spreading-differentiation sequence before 77:38 combines gathering with separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies centrifugal motion, spreading, discrimination, gathering, and separation; I infer a process in which recollection enables final sorting. A live alternative is that the opening actions are parallel oath images rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and separation are two unexplained actions of a tribunal.
changed_reading.after: The day regathers what has been dispersed so that deliberate distinction, rather than random fragmentation, can be completed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible marks are erased, the overhead enclosure is opened, and mountains are removed before humanity is gathered; the focus separation therefore installs a decisive boundary after familiar spatial boundaries have failed.

activation_trace.role: Making a boundary visible supplies the new distinction after cosmic boundaries collapse.
Recollecting scattered parties creates the field in which the new boundary can operate.
Erasure of trace removes a familiar celestial marker.
An opened gap breaks the enclosing continuity of the sky.
Uprooting and removal clear the mountain boundary from its place.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 removes celestial, overhead, and terrestrial landmarks in sequence before the human assembly of 77:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erased, opened, and removed landmarks followed by gathering and separation; I infer that judicial distinction replaces obsolete spatial distinction. A live alternative is that the cosmic changes signal scale and terror without specifying the basis of judgment.

changed_reading.before: Separation sorts people while the world's ordinary coordinates remain conceptually intact.
changed_reading.after: After old coordinates are erased, the gathered multitude receives a newly authoritative moral and judicial boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The former cohort is first shown destroyed and the later cohort following it; the focus then gathers the addressed group with those former people, converting chronology into a single chain of precedent and liability.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without scattering or loss makes the generational assembly exhaustive.
Beginning and precedence identify the earlier cohort recalled at the assembly.
Falling into destruction gives the former cohort a concrete prior outcome.
The repeated precedence term links the focus cohort directly to the earlier destroyed group.
Continuous following turns separate generations into a consequential sequence.
Later status after the former cohort supplies the other end of the sequence.

structural_cues: 77:16-18 moves from former people to later people and a repeated mode of action; 77:38 explicitly reconvenes the addressees with the former group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction of former people, later people following, and their joint assembly with the addressees; I infer precedent and shared liability across the sequence. A live alternative is that following denotes only repetition of fate, not a procession into one historical chain.

changed_reading.before: The former people are remote attendees added for comprehensiveness.
changed_reading.after: They are the precedent cohort whose outcome the later cohorts follow, while the focus gathers every link of that liability chain into one present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reproductive material is held in a stable lodging to a limit, then earth grips living and dead; against that sequence, exhaustive gathering and the weaning branch of separation suggest a terminal release-and-sorting phase in a repeated containment cycle.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without loss makes the final gathering a complete recollection from prior containers.
An offspring separated from maternal support supplies the exploratory release image.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies the material entering the first containment stage.
Fixity and stable settlement characterize the first holding place.
A measured limit supplies the point at which containment must end.
Gripping and enclosing in a vessel recasts earth as the second container.
Animate life identifies one class held by the earthly container.
Loss of life identifies the contrasting class held in the same earth.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 places reproductive material in a stable lodging until a measured term.
77:25-26 describes earth as holding both living and dead before 77:38 gathers all generations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two holding systems, a measured release point, living and dead, exhaustive gathering, and a weaning branch; I infer a repeated containment-to-release pattern. A live alternative is that the creation and earth passages are independent proofs of power rather than a lifecycle template for the focus.

changed_reading.before: The multitude is gathered directly into a tribunal.
changed_reading.after: The assembly can also be carried as a final release and recollection: held to term, held by earth, then brought out completely to be separated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathered multitude resembles parties before judgment, but speech, authorization, excuse, and counter-strategy are successively unavailable; separation is therefore an irreversible ruling rather than a negotiated classification.

activation_trace.role: The assembled multitude supplies the parties placed before the ruling.
Decisive judgment supplies a ruling no longer open to alteration.
The excuse branch identifies the defense that the context prevents them from presenting.
Ordinary speech is explicitly unavailable, closing verbal advocacy.
Permission or authorization is withheld, closing the procedural route to defense.
The challenge to contrivance exposes counter-strategy as equally powerless.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 removes speech and excuse immediately before 77:38, while 77:39 challenges any remaining strategy immediately after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembled parties, decisive judgment, barred speech and excuse, and a futile challenge to scheme; I infer procedural closure. A live alternative is that silence and challenge express helplessness without invoking a hearing model.

changed_reading.before: The people are gathered for a judgment whose process is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: They are gathered at the point when no defense or counter-move can alter the decisive ruling.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the common assembly, the surah contrasts denied cover with protective cover, recompense with criminality, and enduring provision with brief enjoyment; separation becomes concrete allocation into different material and temporal regimes.

activation_trace.role: A mixed multitude supplies the common population before allocation.
Judicial distinction supplies the rule that directs the contrasting outcomes.
Guilt or offense identifies the class assigned only brief enjoyment.
The covering function of shade is explicitly denied in one destination.
Shelter and protection supply the materially opposite destination.
Answering an act with its recompense gives the allocation a judicial basis.
A period preserved for enjoyment supplies the losing group's temporary allowance.
Smallness sharply limits that allowance and creates the temporal contrast.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 denies effective shade, 77:41-44 grants protected shade and recompense, and 77:46 limits the criminals' enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one assembly followed by opposed shelters, recompense, criminality, and limited enjoyment; I infer that these scenes materialize the focus separation. A live alternative is that they are independent warning and reward scenes rather than the immediate allocation stage of 77:38.

changed_reading.before: The judgment distinguishes the gathered people in an abstract legal sense.
changed_reading.after: The common assembly is the staging point for allocation into materially opposite protections and sharply different durations of enjoyment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the formal-separator branch onto surah composition; it remains anchored in the focus separation lexeme and the repeated denier refrain around the focus. Render it as compositional resonance, not as a claim that the lexeme's direct contextual sense is merely a verse divider.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The formal-separator branch of the focus separation term, joined to gathering as wholeness.

activation_trace.role: Formal divisions that regulate text or verse make the focus term available as a compositional hinge.
Wholeness without loss lets the hinge gather the surah's discrete warning panels into one structure.
Attribution of falsehood names the recurring addressee category at an early refrain boundary.
The same category recurs immediately before the focus and marks its incoming boundary.
Its recurrence immediately after the challenge closes the focus unit as another formal panel.

changed_reading.before: The focus only reports the content of the final event.
changed_reading.after: The focus also resonates as the compositional hinge where repeatedly separated warning panels are gathered under the explicit name of separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping of the former-people root toward adjacency and succession. It remains formally packet-licensed and anchored in the focus occurrence, but render it only as a secondary spatial-temporal resonance; it must not replace the dominant beginning-and-precedence reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The former-people occurrence is gathered with the addressees and has a non-dominant mapped branch of gapless nearness.

activation_trace.role: Gapless nearness turns remote predecessors into immediate neighbors within the assembly.
Continuous succession supplies a chain in which generations arrive one after another.
Gathering scattered parties into one whole converts succession into co-presence.

changed_reading.before: Former generations remain conceptually remote even though they attend the same event.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, gathering abolishes the gap between successive generations and makes remote predecessors immediate neighbors.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the focus declaration as performative as well as predictive. It remains anchored in the articulating-speech branch of separation and the closing question about later discourse and belief. Render it as a present rhetorical enactment layered onto the eschatological event, never as a reduction of that event to recitation alone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus declaration uses a separation term whose inventory includes articulation by speech.

activation_trace.role: Articulating speech that distinguishes matters lets the declaration itself perform a verbal separation.
The withholding of ordinary speech makes the authoritative focus declaration stand out as the speech that controls the scene.
Renewed report or discourse frames the surah as a communicative event demanding response.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response whose presence or absence divides hearers.

changed_reading.before: The utterance only describes a separation that will occur later.
changed_reading.after: The declaration also begins separating hearers now by articulating the decisive report to which belief or refusal responds.

strongest_changes: The demonstrative declaration became the arrival of a previously promised, appointed, and deferred deadline.
Gathering became the reversal of dispersal and the prerequisite for controlled distinction.
Former and later generations became one chain of precedent and liability rather than merely a large crowd.
Judicial separation became concrete in barred defense and allocation into opposed shelters and durations.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the apparent tension between gathering and separation functional: earlier dispersal, collapsed cosmic boundaries, generational succession, bodily containment, procedural closure, repeated refrains, and contrasting destinations all converge on the focus as a collection staged for decisive distinction.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening dispersal-to-sorting sequence is mechanically coherent, but the packet does not require its oath images to be sequential stages or identify their agents.
The containment, weaning, formal-separator, and performative-speech readings are branch-driven analogies and should not displace the direct judicial reading.
The adjacency reading depends on a non-dominant split mapping and is only a contained resonance beside the dominant precedence sense.
